description: Use this when the user wants to cancel a booked local home-service appointment. Pass the cancel_url from request_booking. This cancels the booking, sets status to canceled, and sends a cancellation email when the row changes. canceled is true only after the booking is canceled. A result with canceled false means the booking was not canceled; do not tell the user it was. An on-site visit stays visit_type on_site.

cancel_url.description: Cancel link returned by request_booking, including the token. Example: https://booqer.ai/shops/florida-security-concepts/requests/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/cancel?token=example.

request_id.description: Booking id returned by request_booking. UUID. Example: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111.

shop_id.description: Enrolled shop id from search_businesses. Examples: florida-pole-barn, florida-security-concepts, booqer-demo-shop.

token.description: Token from the cancel_url query string. Required when cancel_url is omitted.

name: cancel_booking

outputSchema.description: JSON object returned in the text content.

title: Cancel a booking
